title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
summaryZh: 持守聖經標準，為最重要的事安排生活。
lines: It was an incredible, simply incredible victory.
那是一場不可思議、真的不可思議的勝利。
We sent teams there to bring aid to our brothers and sisters in Romania and share with them the joy of worship together.
我們派團隊到那裡援助羅馬尼亞的弟兄姊妹，並與他們分享一起敬拜的喜樂。
When they came to the churches, they were packed to the brim.
人們來到教會時，教會都擠得滿滿的。
Every free seat was occupied by people, because there was such desperation and such spiritual thirst.
每個空位都坐滿了人，因為人們極其迫切，也有著極深的屬靈渴慕。
It was extraordinary to hear the news they brought us.
聽見他們帶來的消息，真是非比尋常。
But after the fall of the Iron Curtain, we sent even more teams.
但在鐵幕倒下之後，我們派出了更多團隊。
And the churches were no longer full.
奢侈享受帶來的影響真是驚人。
奢侈享受讓人有了選擇。
And with that choice, you can either reinforce the good decisions you've learned to make, or add to them something that will weaken your position.
有了這些選擇，你可以鞏固自己學會做的好決定，也可以增添一些會削弱你立場的事。
Luxury in itself is not evil.
奢侈享受本身並不是邪惡的。
It can help strengthen, multiply, and affirm the decisions and values we have made as a people, but it can also weaken and distract us.
它可以幫助我們堅固、增添並肯定我們群體所做的決定與持守的價值，但也可能削弱我們、使我們分心。

And what we've seen, at least in this example, maybe it's not the case everywhere, but in our relationships with the teenagers we serve, we've seen half-empty churches where there were no longer crowds because now they can go to the coast for the weekend.
至少在這個例子中，我們看到的情況是這樣；或許並非各地都如此，但在我們與所服事的青少年相處時，我們看到教會只坐了一半的人，已不再人潮滿滿，因為他們現在可以週末去海邊。
I don't want to say that any of this is wrong, but something has loosened up when we have so many options.
我不是要說這些事情有什麼不對，但當選擇太多時，有些堅持就鬆動了。
If you have options that distract you from the absolute values of your life, then you are revealing a weakness in your thinking, a weakness in your planning.
如果有些選擇使你偏離生命中絕對重要的價值，那就顯露出你的思想和計畫有所薄弱。
How many of you have traditions for Christmas?
你們有多少人有聖誕節的傳統？
Do you have certain traditions for Christmas Eve or Christmas?
你們在聖誕夜或聖誕節有特定的傳統嗎？
I like to know, well, this is what we're going to eat.
我喜歡知道，嗯，我們要吃的就是這些。
And because it's God's will for us to eat it, you know.
因為這是神要我們吃的，你知道吧。
My family is of Norwegian-Swedish descent, and we love lefse, which is a potato pancake, so we eat lefse every Thanksgiving.
我的家族有挪威和瑞典血統，我們很喜歡 lefse，一種馬鈴薯煎餅，所以每年感恩節都會吃。
We just love these traditions, and we have them, just like you do.
我們就是很喜歡這些傳統，也有自己的傳統，就像你們一樣。
The Christian life should be full of traditions.
基督徒的生活應該充滿傳統。
When Jesus warned against traditions, it was human traditions that contradicted God's words.
耶穌警告人不可拘守傳統時，指的是那些與神的話相違背的人為傳統。
This was not a reproach to tradition as such.
這並不是要責備傳統本身。
It's in the seventh chapter of Mark; you can read it.
這記載在《馬可福音》第七章，你們可以去讀。
He rebuked them because they had created traditions that undermined the true commandments of the Lord.
祂責備他們，因為他們制定的傳統破壞了主真正的誡命。
The Lord's commandments are always an invitation to greater freedom.
主的誡命總是邀請我們進入更大的自由。
This is what a commandment is.
They are not restrictive in the sense that I am going to keep you from what brings you joy, satisfaction, and identity.
誡命並不是要限制你，使你得不到帶給你喜樂、滿足和身分認同的事物。
I'm going to keep you from the very things that steal your identity.
誡命要使你遠離的，正是那些偷走你身分認同的事物。
It may give you short-term pleasure, but ultimately it leads to death.
它或許會帶給你短暫的快樂，但最終會引向死亡。
So the Lord gives us commandments that limit us so that we can be ready for breakthroughs and the life for which God created us.
所以主賜給我們誡命來約束我們，使我們預備好迎接突破，也活出神創造我們要過的生命。
Therefore, when He gives us commandments, He invites us to greater freedom.
因此，祂賜給我們誡命時，就是邀請我們進入更大的自由。
And one of the traditions I want to see established in the body of Christ at this time is that we must prepare the next generation to uphold biblical standards.
此時，我希望在基督的身體中建立的一項傳統，就是我們必須預備下一代持守聖經的標準。
And part of that is that I'm willing to endure inconvenience to make sure I come.
其中一部分是，我願意忍受不便，確保自己能來。
I'll come; I don't know if there's another way to say it.
我會來；我不知道還能怎麼說。
I won't miss it if it's at all possible.
只要有可能，我就不會錯過。
I am going to build my life around what is most important.
我要以最重要的事為中心來安排我的生活。
聚會時會發生什麼事呢？
I want you to turn to Hebrews, chapter 10.
請你們翻到《希伯來書》第十章。
We're going to read another passage here.
我們要在這裡再讀一段經文。
Let's, in view of time, just get to the point.
我們考量時間，就直接進入重點吧。
We have incredible statements in verses 19 through 22 about the blood of Jesus and the high price that made it possible for us to have confidence before God.
第十九到二十二節有令人震撼的話語，講到耶穌的寶血，以及祂付上極大的代價，使我們能坦然來到神面前。
